item.tib: 'phags pa byams pa'i mdo zhes bya ba
item.skt: Ar+ya mai trI sU traM nA ma
item.coloph: 'phags pa byams pa'i mdo rdzogs s+ho// //thub dbang mchog dang rgyal ba byams pa yi/ /bstan pa gsal byed mdo sde'i dbang po 'di/ /yon tan dang ldan sing ga gling yul gyi/ /stong phrag mang po'i dge 'du kun gyi gtso/ /mar me mdzad slob rdo rje gdan bzhugs pa/ /paN chen A nan da shrI yon tan can/ /dge slong chos kyi spyan can skad gnyis mkhas/ /bstan la phan 'dod bzang po de nyid dang / /de'i legs gtugs dge slong lung rigs 'dzin/ /skad gnyis smra ba mchog gi rjes 'jug pa/ /kun dga' rgyal mtshan thub bstan dpal bzang pos/ /ston pa 'das nas lo stong brgyad brgya dang / /lnga bcu lhag pa'i zla ba bcu 'das dus/ /chos kyi rgyal po ha shang mnga' gsol tshe/ /me lug dgun zla ra ba'i yar ngo la/ /dpal ldan bla ma kun dga' seng ge yi/ /skun drin la brten dpal ldan sa skyar ni/ /sgra don ji bzhin legs par bsgyur ba yin/ /'phags nor rgyan ldan skyes bu dam pa rnams/ /dam chos rin chen 'di la gtsug rgyan mdzod/ /nyon mongs nad can phrag dog rab rib can/ /chos sman 'di sten nad med mig gsal 'gyur/ /dge ba 'di gzhan ma lus legs bsdoms te/ /bla ma thub dbang byams pa mgon la sogs/ /sangs rgyas kun mnyes rnam dag rgya chen zhing /rnam dag rab bsgrubs bstan pa mchog bsgrubs nas/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing rdul snyed kyi sprul pa yis/ /sems can thams cad bstan la dad byas shing / /sangs rgyas bstan pa rab tu rgyas byas te/ /sangs rgyas sku gsum ye shes myur thob shog_/shes bya mtha' yas rab tu zab phyir dang / /shes byed tshad can rab tu rtogs sla'i phyir/ /'khrul par gyur na rab tu sems dge ba'i phyir/ /skye bo mkhas rnams rab tu bzod mdzad rigs/ /rgya dpe dang legs par btugs so/ /phyogs dus thams cad du bkra shis dang bde legs kyis khyab par gyur cig
